d2d_to_attention_rx.note: att_rx 548 b local at the d2d end (plan (b) attention control tile); the legacy sequencer home was 4 stages away (d2d_kv.srx -> seq.srx)

programme_to_groups.note: lprg -> per-group control tiles (phase launch, landing calendar, K issuer) along the legacy seq -> landing corridor; one equalised registered tree (the die pads the near stacks) so one root reaches all 32 groups on one edge

group_internal.note: phase launch, front calendar and the four pc_path calendars share the per-group control tile / abut it; landing calendar beside its landing segment

return_to_landing_ld.note: qkd_kv_landing_cal LD = return-slot output register + relays; pc_path children abut their landing group

astk_law.scope: expanded ASTK strip (OT_KV_ASTK_EXPAND=1: RL 3, ctl Z stride 4, distributed e-read ERL 42) relative to the RL 1 / star ERL 7 strip; measured on the actual qkd_astk_strip_er_st (ctl_s, 8 ep_s, 32 ex_s, 4 zn, mapped score/e SRAM) by tb_qkd_astk_calendar, Verilator 5.050 ot-epyc4
astk_law.verification: shift_check.tsv: D passes at (stride16 RL1 star minima) + (dLMAX, dEXP, dZ) for T 1..8192 and fails at dZ-1 (tight); every minimum PASS with min-1 FAIL (sweep*.tsv); D mutants ep_s / ctl_s FAIL (mutant_*.log)
astk_law.stride: A (stride 16) and B (stride 4) strip minima are identical: the ctl Z stride changes only the Z output duration (hub side)
